headline: BDH Architecture Demonstrates Superior Structural Stability and Continual Learning Capabilities
key_findings: BDH achieves 0.61 modularity vs 0.22 for randomized control
BDH retains 90.1% Task A accuracy after Task B training vs 71.6% for Transformer
BDH outperforms Transformer on all long-context reasoning tasks
Activation sparsity of 84.2% indicates efficient computation
